request.message: Use Azure for this synthetic architecture qualification. Build an authenticated conversational assistant for synthetic users. Include an application, per-user conversation state, model runtime, bounded context and an escalation path. No external actions in this first test. Acceptance criteria: One user cannot read another conversation; Context and response sizes are bounded; Model outage produces a recoverable response; Deleting a conversation removes its stored context; Escalation retains the approved conversation context. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.
